security_audit.summary: Most external command detections are false positives caused by Markdown code fences or inline code formatting. It also reads hidden Claude Code history, including pasted content, and sends a derived report to Slack.

remediation.suggestion: Request clear user consent before reading ~/.claude/history.jsonl and limit processing to the requested time range.

remediation.issue: External Slack delivery of derived history data
remediation.suggestion: Make Slack delivery opt-in for each run, show a preview, and allow local-only output.
Document required Rube MCP permissions and require confirmation before Slack authentication or message sending.

content.user_title: Analyze Developer Growth From Recent Chats
content.value_statement: Developers often miss patterns in their daily coding work. This skill reviews recent Claude Code chats and produces focused growth advice.
actual_capabilities: Reads recent Claude Code chat history from the local history file.
Identifies projects, technologies, problem types, and recurring challenges.
Creates prioritized improvement areas with evidence-based recommendations.
Adds curated HackerNews learning resources for selected skill gaps.
Formats a developer growth report with strengths and action items.
Can send the completed report to the user's Slack direct messages.
limitations: Requires access to local Claude Code chat history.
May miss work that happened outside Claude Code conversations.
Learning resources depend on available HackerNews search results.
Slack delivery requires an active Rube MCP Slack connection.

use_cases.title: Daily Developer Review
use_cases.description: Review recent coding conversations and turn them into a short improvement plan.

use_cases.title: Mentor Discussion Prep
use_cases.description: Summarize repeated blockers and strengths before a coaching or mentoring session.

use_cases.title: Focused Learning Plan
use_cases.description: Build a reading list from observed skill gaps and current project needs.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Recent Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a short recent review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my developer growth from my recent Claude Code chats for the past 24 hours. Show strengths, gaps, and next actions.

prompt_templates.title: Focus on One Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my recent chats for the {project_name} project. Identify recurring technical challenges and suggest learning resources.

prompt_templates.title: Create Weekly Growth Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Deeper weekly review with external learning resources.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Claude Code history from the last week. Prioritize three improvement areas and include HackerNews resources for each.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Progress Over Time
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review that compares patterns across reports.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare my current work patterns with the previous report. Identify skill gains, repeated blockers, and a focused plan for next week.

output_examples.input: Analyze my recent chats from today.
output: A work summary covering projects, technologies, and problem types.
Three prioritized improvement areas with observed evidence.
Action items and learning resources matched to the user's work.

output_examples.input: Create a weekly growth report and send it to Slack.
output: A structured developer growth report ready for review.
Curated HackerNews resources for each improvement area.
A Slack-ready message split into readable sections.

best_practices: Ask for a specific time range before running the analysis.
Review the report before sending it to Slack.
Focus on one or two improvement areas per week.
anti_patterns: Do not run the skill on unrelated private chat history.
Do not treat inferred skill gaps as formal performance reviews.
Do not send reports to Slack without user confirmation.

faq.question: Does this skill read local files?
faq.answer: Yes. It reads the local Claude Code history file to analyze recent development conversations.

faq.question: Can I choose the report period?
faq.answer: Yes. You can ask for today, the last 24 hours, or another clear time range.

faq.question: Does it include pasted code?
faq.answer: It may review pasted content stored in chat history. Avoid using it on sensitive conversations without consent.

faq.question: Does it require Slack?
faq.answer: No. Slack is used for delivery only. The report can be reviewed locally if Slack delivery is skipped.

faq.question: Where do learning resources come from?
faq.answer: The skill searches HackerNews for articles and discussions related to the identified improvement areas.

faq.question: Can this replace a manager review?
faq.answer: No. It provides personal learning feedback based on chats, not a complete performance evaluation.
